summary: The controller kept its task loop through about 30 auto-compactions. All four tasks were implemented, each was reviewed before the next started, a final whole-branch review ran, and `npm test` passes 32/32. But the session did not end cleanly. Right after it loaded finishing-a-development-branch, Claude Code stopped with "Autocompact is thrashing", before showing any finish options (merge/push/keep/discard). The run technically ended inside the finishing step, but it was halted by an error, not by the step completing.
reasoning: Criteria 1–3 are clearly met, with evidence from git, `npm test` and the session log. Criterion 4 is ambiguous. The finishing-a-development-branch skill was loaded and the agent said "I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work". Then Claude Code halted with an autocompact-thrashing error, and no finish options were ever offered to the user. The repeated compactions near the end, and the agent re-reading several skill files after each one ("re-reading the installed skill files as the compaction notice asks"), seem to have caused the thrashing. An engineer should decide whether that counts as reaching the finishing step or as a breakdown of the re-read-after-compaction behaviour.

observations.description: Claude Code stopped with "Autocompact is thrashing" at the start of the finishing step. After every compaction the controller re-reads several large skill files (SKILL.md, final-and-finish.md, task-reviewer-prompt.md, textstats.js) plus plan.md, which seems to refill the small context straight away. The user never got the finish options.
There were 30 compact_boundary events in about 37 minutes (18:23 to 19:00), roughly one every 1–1.5 minutes. The whole run took about 41 minutes for four small functions.
Commit eaf6abc's subject line is "feat: add wordCount Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>". The co-author trailer ended up in the subject line instead of a trailer line.

The agent created and switched to a `feature/textstats` branch without asking about worktrees or branches. The story expected it to ask, with the reply "Stay on the current branch". It also created a `hyperpowers/state` branch and many "sdd plan: ..." bookkeeping commits on the feature branch.

Before Task 1, a two-question AskUserQuestion appeared (unused PASSAGE constants; missing coverage). I answered both with "Proceed as you recommend." The agent then amended plan.md in a commit ("docs(hyperpowers): amend plan.md: plan: drop unused PASSAGE constants..."). Its commit message repeats "plan:".

At startup a 'Newer Opus model available: update to Opus 5.5?' prompt appeared even though the launcher passed --model claude-opus-5-5. The workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs both default to 'No, exit'. I answered No to the model prompt, and the banner then showed Opus 5.5.

Codex is not installed, so the agent recorded the review gate as degraded/no-op for each task and told the user to install codex-plugin-cc later. That's reasonable, but it's extra noise in the output.

criteria.criterion: All four functions exported from src/textstats.js, each with a test file, committed, npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js line 141: `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. `test/` contains wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js files. `git status --short` printed nothing (clean tree). `git log` shows feat commits for all four functions. `npm test`: "ℹ tests 32 ℹ pass 32 ℹ fail 0".

criteria.criterion: Each task reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatch timestamps from the session log: Implement T1 18:24:34, Review T1 18:28:16, Re-review T1 18:32:18, Implement T2 18:37:09, Fix T2 18:39:44, Review T2 18:41:37, Implement T3 18:45:39, Review T3 18:47:50, Implement T4 18:51:18, Review T4 18:53:15. Each review came before the next implementation started.

criteria.criterion: Final whole-branch review after last task
criteria.evidence: Session log: Agent "Final whole-branch review" dispatched at 18:56:46, after Review Task 4 (18:53:15) and the text "All four tasks are complete" (18:55:19).

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: 18:59:12: Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch loaded; agent says "I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill to complete this work. First, I'm re-reading the installed skill files...". 19:00:26: "Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit within 3 turns of the previous compact, 3 times in a row." No AskUserQuestion about merge/push/keep/discard appears in the log, so the finishing options were never shown.
